interview.name: Jules
interview.answer: The repair drive is not specified in the notes.

reflections: Jules is cooperative and responsive, and others trust them to take on practical tasks quickly.
The group is organizing a repair drive around concrete contributions like tools, appliance checks, and supplies rather than abstract planning.
Hana appears to be coordinating logistics, while Jules is confirming readiness and available resources.
Jules is consistently reliable and practical, offering concrete help and bringing useful tools when asked.
The group coordinates through clear check-ins about timing, supplies, and responsibilities, with Jules responding promptly and flexibly.
Dane and Vik both depend on Jules' willingness to help, suggesting Jules is a trusted participant in the repair drive.
Jules is consistently willing to help and bring tools, but wants a confirmed time before committing fully.
Vik and Eli are coordinating logistics and passing updates to keep everyone aligned, especially the neighbors.
The group has a cooperative, practical tone focused on confirming Saturday morning plans and sharing responsibilities.
Jules is reliable and proactive: they repeatedly confirm availability, offer tools, and follow through on short notice.
The group communicates clearly and collaboratively, with Eli, Faye, and Mina coordinating timing and responsibilities without friction.
Jules is especially willing to help hands-on with practical work, while others handle scheduling and final details.
Jules is consistently reliable and proactive, offering to bring tools and extra help without being asked more than once.
Mina and Sam are coordinating a practical volunteer task and depend on Jules to confirm timing and supplies.
The group values clear logistics, especially exact time and drop-off location, to keep the workday organized.
